commits_of_this_work_package.subject: Render the run, final and verification reports from one reading, and record the published state. [WP-EDGE-06]
Audit the frozen books, decompose the intraday loss, and run three newly registered families. [WP-EDGE-06]
Make the scheduled tick the trigger for the lane's derived reading, and declare the volume in the WP-9B tests. [WP-EDGE-06]
Register the Track B hypotheses and their parameters before any out-of-sample run. [WP-EDGE-06]
Version WP-EDGE-06's storage artefacts, which are the first readings of this work package. [WP-EDGE-06]
Regenerate the derived state view at HEAD so the rehearsal has a commit to rehearse. [WP-EDGE-06]
